url_business_offer.description: Live document URL for the Business Services Public Offer, opened from Settings → Legal and the acceptance checkbox in venue creation/renewal.

business_offer_version.description: Current version of the Business Services Public Offer. Compared against a venue's stored offerAcceptedVersion to decide whether re-acceptance is required before the next subscription payment.

business_offer_effective_date.description: ISO date shown in the in-app "offer updated" banner when business_offer_version changes.

url_child_safety_standards.description: Google Play child safety standards page, linked from Settings → Legal.
